title: Using Lockout and Tagout Procedures to Prevent Injury and Death during Machine Maintenance
publisher: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health
notes: NIOSH Workplace Solutions publication supporting the risk of hazardous-energy exposure during machine maintenance/servicing and the recommendation for a hazardous-energy control program with lockout/tagout procedures and worker training. It is a safety recommendation/evidence source, not a substitute for determining which legal standard applies to a particular cultivation workplace. Verified against the current CDC/NIOSH publication page on 2026-09-15.
